replay.detail: No new projection invalidation or startup replay trigger in the merged OMP native transcript binding change.

schema.detail: No database table, index, trigger or migration change in OMP native transcript binding; SQLite user_version is unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digest/drop policy are unchanged; this change adds no sealing coordination requirement.

compatibility.detail: OMP session and ready frames now supply the native transcript path through the existing optional sessionFile field when its getter is available. An absent getter does not block readiness; no new channel schema is introduced.

downtime.detail: Restarting an affected OMP seat temporarily interrupts that seat while its new incarnation starts and binds. Other seats and the daemon API need no additional stop for this repair; no repair duration was measured.

manual.detail: Already-running OMP seats with a pathless transcript binding need a restart with the new hook asset. Their old native-session report is idempotency-pinned per incarnation/session and cannot heal in place. Restart the affected seat, then verify its transcript opens in the client; daemon upgrade alone does not repair that saved binding.

recovery.detail: No additional recovery procedure introduced by this change. Preserve graph state, keys and configuration and follow the standard roll-forward guidance; this note does not qualify binary-only downgrade of the whole release.
